sentences.pinyin: Biànjīng shì Sòng cháo de dū chéng.
sentences.meaning: Bianjing was the capital of the Song Dynasty.

sentences.pinyin: Dà jiē shàng rén hěn duō.
sentences.meaning: There were many people on the main street.

sentences.pinyin: Jiē shàng yǒu chē, yǒu mǎ, yǒu qiáo.
sentences.meaning: On the street there were carts, horses, and bridges.

sentences.pinyin: Wǎnshàng, dēng hěn liàng.
sentences.meaning: At night, the lanterns were very bright.

sentences.pinyin: Sòng cháo rén hěn ài hē chá.
sentences.meaning: Song Dynasty people loved to drink tea.

sentences.chinese: 茶馆是人们聊天的地方。
sentences.pinyin: Chá guǎn shì rénmen liáo tiān de dìfang.
sentences.meaning: Tea houses were places where people chatted.

sentences.pinyin: Tāmen yòng chá bēi hē chá.
sentences.meaning: They used tea cups to drink tea.

sentences.pinyin: Sòng cháo de shìchǎng hěn rènao.
sentences.meaning: The Song Dynasty market was very lively.

sentences.chinese: 人们在这里买包子和豆腐。
sentences.pinyin: Rénmen zài zhèlǐ mǎi bāozi hé dòufu.
sentences.meaning: People bought steamed buns and tofu here.

sentences.pinyin: Hái yǒu miàntiáo hé jiǎozi.
sentences.meaning: There were also noodles and dumplings.

sentences.pinyin: Měi gè tānwèi dōu hěn hǎo chī!
sentences.meaning: Every stall had delicious food!

sentences.pinyin: Sòng cháo de sīchóu hěn yǒumíng.
sentences.meaning: Song Dynasty silk was very famous.

sentences.pinyin: Rénmen yòng sīchóu zuò yīfu.
sentences.meaning: People used silk to make clothes.

sentences.pinyin: Sīchóu yǒu hěn duō yánsè.
sentences.meaning: Silk came in many colors.

sentences.pinyin: Sìmiào hěn ānjìng.
sentences.meaning: The temple was very quiet.

sentences.pinyin: Héshang zài zhèlǐ qídǎo.
sentences.meaning: Monks prayed here.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ tīng dào zhōng shēng.
sentences.meaning: You could hear the sound of bells.

sentences.pinyin: Kōngqì zhōng yǒu xiāng de wèidào.
sentences.meaning: The air smelled of incense.

sentences.pinyin: Yù huāyuán hěn dà hěn měi.
sentences.meaning: The imperial garden was large and beautiful.

sentences.pinyin: Huāyuán lǐ yǒu huā hé liǔ shù.
sentences.meaning: In the garden there were flowers and willow trees.

sentences.pinyin: Chí lǐ yǒu yú.
sentences.meaning: There were fish in the pond.

sentences.pinyin: Jǐngsè fēicháng měilì.
sentences.meaning: The scenery was very beautiful.

sentences.chinese: 宋朝有很多伟大的发明。
sentences.pinyin: Sòng cháo yǒu hěn duō wěidà de fāmíng.
sentences.meaning: The Song Dynasty had many great inventions.

sentences.pinyin: Huózì yìnshuā ràng shū biàn duō le.
sentences.meaning: Movable type printing made books more common.

sentences.pinyin: Huǒyào kěyǐ zuò yānhuā.
sentences.meaning: Gunpowder could make fireworks.

sentences.chinese: 指南针帮助人们找到方向。
sentences.pinyin: Zhǐnánzhēn bāngzhù rénmen zhǎo dào fāngxiàng.
sentences.meaning: The compass helped people find their way.
